infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow MeetActions to access your microphone to record meeting audio and provide real-time AI transcription.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow MeetActions to access your camera to capture whiteboards and presentation slides during meetings.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow MeetActions to access your photos to upload presentation slides.

plugins.microphonePermission: Allow MeetActions to access your microphone to record and analyze meeting audio.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow MeetActions to access your gallery for whiteboard photos.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow MeetActions to use your camera for capturing whiteboard data.

plugins.calendarPermission: Allow MeetActions to access your calendar to sync meeting tasks.
plugins.remindersPermission: Allow MeetActions to access your reminders for task notifications.
